mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_behavior_log (user_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, session_id, duration_sec, metadata_json, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{actionType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{sessionId}, #{durationSec}, #{metadataJson}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(create_time)) AS uniqueDates, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(duration_sec, 0)), 0) AS totalDurationSec, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'VIEW_RESOURCE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS viewResourceCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'ANSWER_QUIZ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS answerQuizCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'COMPLETE_NODE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completeNodeCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'CONVERSATION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS conversationCount FROM learning_behavior_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY)

SELECT action_type AS actionType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM learning_behavior_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY) GROUP BY action_type ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(duration_sec, 0)), 0) / 60 AS minutes, COUNT(*) AS actionCount FROM learning_behavior_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DISTINCT DATE(create_time) AS active_date FROM learning_behavior_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY) ORDER BY active_date DESC LIMIT 60
